blocked_interpretations: Do not report G45 as photometric reconstruction quality.
Do not compare G45 to RGB PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS or SOTA tables.
Do not treat similarity/ICP alignment as camera recovery or metric coordinate recovery.
Do not use held-out RGB pixels for training; this gate consumes only masks/depth arrays derived from the GT mesh.
Do not publish private Multiface/LAM PNG/MP4/PLY/OBJ outputs without explicit artifact review.
Do not reintroduce experiments/downstream_datasets as training or evaluation data.
data_gate: PASS_REAL_GT_HELDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC. Inputs are G21/G23 Multiface real captured cameras/masks/depth, G42 private LAM shaped mesh, and G44 similarity transform. No pseudo-view candidate pool, experiments/downstream_datasets export, LAM motion-camera MP4, or held-out RGB image is used for training or committed output.
decision: G45 is the first held-out-camera geometry diagnostic for the learned-prior route. It checks whether the aligned LAM mesh projects into held-out Multiface cameras with non-catastrophic silhouette/depth agreement. It remains below a final method result because it uses similarity-aligned mesh geometry, not the native learned-prior camera frame or RGB held-out rendering.
premise: Use the G44 similarity-aligned LAM shaped mesh and the G23 real-camera adapter to render geometry into held-out Multiface cameras, then compare silhouette and z-buffer depth against held-out GT masks/depth arrays without committing private images or meshes.
